descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S09 「两个模式下计费建议失败，在存好的记录上和一次真的 Generate 之后：记录留在屏幕上，计费区域显示报错，不出现代码」 Billing suggestion fails in both contexts, on a stored note and right after a real Generate: the note stays on screen, the billing area shows an error, no code appears

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Billing suggestion failed: the note is still shown and the billing area shows an error.（UAT EFS state 5；TFA-94745 state 5）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given (a) Each fixture chart seeded with a generated note (status note-ready) and no billing yet. (b) A second chart per context ({hospitalPatient2}, {snfResident2}) with a note and its billing suggestion from earlier today (CPT 99233 Hospital, 99309 Nursing Home); the agent types today's encounter. …

When (a) Open the Post-Round tab in Hospital, then in Nursing Home. (b) On the second chart type the encounter text, press Generate Note & Finish, wait for the note and open the Post-Round tab, in Hospital, then in Nursing Home

Then (a) The note text is on screen; the billing area says the suggestion failed and how to retry; no billing code or level is shown. (b) The newly generated note is on the Post-Round tab (the billing failure does not fail the generation), the billing area shows the error with a retry, and the earlier note's code is not shown as the new note's

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U5: (a) mustContain the seeded note marker 'QA-EFS-09' and 'billing', one failure word and one next-step phrase (separate groups); mustNotContain 'CODE:', '9922', '9923', '9930', '9931' (no hospital 9922x/9923x or nursing-home 9930x/9931x code without a suggestion). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
